verdict.rationale: Baseten documents programmatic surfaces for its core workflows. Models deploy via CLI (`baseten model push` / `truss push`), training steps are API calls, checkpoints deploy with one CLI command, usage can be queried by API key, and an official MCP server lets agents manage the workspace. However, nothing documents a complete management API or explicit parity with the UI, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement, a documented management/admin REST API spec (OpenAPI), API coverage for workspace settings such as budgets, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so your coding agent can manage your Baseten workspace and search these docs.
then run `baseten model push` to ship it
Deploy any synced checkpoint with one CLI command
each training step is an API call from a Python loop you write.
You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.
